question: The Statue of Unity is located at the bank of which of these rivers?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Narmada River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Statue of Unity** is located near the **Sardar Sarovar Dam** on the banks of the **Narmada River** in the state of **Gujarat**, India.
 
• It is a colossal statue of **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, who was the **first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India**.
 
• The statue was inaugurated on **31st October 2018**, coinciding with the birth anniversary of Sardar Patel, which is celebrated as **National Unity Day**.
 
• The Statue of Unity is the **tallest statue in the world**, with a height of **182 meters**.
